registers: THE CAPTURE-CONDITIONAL REPAIR of the e2e regression that RESULTS-capturability.md §11 measured and its stop rule flagged, with the gates that decide whether it ships. Stamped before the throughput re-run whose data G3 grades exists.
the_change: kernel/nf4_grouped.py::to_device_i32 routes index transfers through the pinned arena ONLY when torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing(); otherwise it performs the pre-change pageable build. The arena is touched on every CUDA call so it exists before any capture begins (pinned allocation inside a capture is the measured-illegal construct), and a capture whose needs exceed the arena refuses BY NAME. Nothing else moves: the per-element int() removals, the .tolist() hoists, output_size=, the host-vs-CUDA eids boundary, and every kernel stay as merged.
mechanism_being_repaired: One mechanism, both signs, measured: removing cudaStreamSynchronize pays only when the GPU pipeline is busy (+6.5-15% at 83-99% busy, §§9-10); on the host-bound e2e step (12-24% busy) the syncs were nearly free and the arena's per-call host work is pure cost (-1.8% median, worst cell -4%, instrument clean to 2.2%, §11). The repair makes the capture-legal path pay its cost only where capture can use it.

frozen_gates.G1_capture: The shipped ladder on the A2000: D_base + G_base(list) + G_base(devtensor) + G_full(list) + G_full(devtensor) + G_stack(48 calls) all CAPTURED, and the arena-exhaustion negative control REFUSES BY NAME. Falsifier: any capture failure — the conditional must not have reintroduced a hazard (the capture discipline's uncaptured warm-up is what guarantees the arena exists and is sized before capture; G_stack exercises exactly that).
frozen_gates.G2_values: Bitwise equality, two independent instruments on the A2000: ab_capturability_bitexact 26/26 tensors vs the current origin/main kernel (torch.equal), and test_eids_forms 4/4 (list, CPU tensor, CUDA tensor identical). Falsifier: any mismatch — the branch may change WHEN a transfer syncs, never a value.
frozen_gates.G3_throughput: The e2e triple re-run on a whole machine (cores == cores_effective asserted from the API readback), pub = the gnf4==0.12.0 wheel (the pre-change tree), cap = this branch. Graded EXACTLY as amendment 1: P2 two-sided 0.967-1.032 on pub2/pub1 (VOIDs the run), P3 one-sided harm floor cap/pub1 of speedup_vs_reference >= 0.967 on every clean cell, G1 sweep self-pairs and drift exclusions unchanged. PREDICTION, falsifiable: every clean cell lands within the instrument's own spread of 1.0 — the not-capturing path IS the pre-change path, so any residual cost is the is_current_stream_capturing() check and the arena existence probe, both nanoseconds against a multi-second step. FALSIFIER: any clean cell below 0.967; and a median visibly below parity (< ~0.99) is reported as a finding even if the floor holds.

what_a_pass_licenses: G1+G2+G3 green closes §11's stop-rule condition the constructive way: the regression is removed rather than adjudicated, capturability is intact, and the change may ship as a patch release. The speed observed at kernel-bound sizes (§§9-10) is unaffected by this repair — under capture and in graph replay the arena path is exactly what ran there... with the caveat that §§9-10 measured the UNCONDITIONAL path outside capture too; a fresh kernel-bound spot-check (2 cells, tokbudget_4096, OLMoE) is run alongside G3 as a REPORTED sanity row, not a graded gate, to confirm the conditional did not forfeit the uncaptured-path win. If that spot-check shows the win gone, that is written down and the kernel-gate claim is re-scoped to captured execution only.
stop_rule: Verbatim write-up of whatever G1-G3 show, including a FAIL of the prediction. No band adjustment, no re-runs for a better number, no dropping cells except by the pre-committed rules. If G3 voids on P2, the next attempt is another whole machine, not a shared pod.
